title: Physics of the Future
locator: Publisher reproduced introduction: physical feasibility, prototypes and scientist interviews provide a basis; failed forecasts and human behavior limit adoption predictions. Utopian language remains and lowers quality scores.

title: Power vs. Force
locator: Author/publisher explanation of the linked book’s method: muscle response is claimed to distinguish truth about anything across time and space. This exceeds demonstrated measurement validity.

title: Quantum Supremacy
locator: Aaronson May 19, 2023 direct review: universal classical incomputability, conflation of parallel paths with usable computation, and inflated cryptographic claims; contrasts actual algorithm and complexity constraints.

title: Remix Judaism
locator: Publisher description: selection, rejection and modification of practices for personal meaning outside commanded observance; it explicitly declines to sell the author’s own exact practices.

title: René Girard's Mimetic Theory
locator: MSU Press description and chapter structure: desire, scapegoating, biblical interpretation and applications to political and social structures are explained as a theory, not commanded belief.

title: Scattered Minds
locator: Author’s book page explicitly calls ADD non-inherited and reversible; the prior genetic-evidence record remains relevant to this unqualified framing.

title: Secret: The Making of Australia's Security State
locator: Tanter’s direct analysis distinguishes Pine Gap systems and identifies distorted use of Des Ball’s arms-control views; its criticism coexists with praise for other reporting.

title: Soul on Ice
locator: Primary scan: printed p.34 (PDF p.47) repudiates rape; printed pp.128–136 (PDF pp.141–149) contain severe homophobic and racialized abuse. Printed p.131 says he seeks no denial of Baldwin’s rights; p.132 compares anti-gay beatings to lynching. This mixed evidence makes the extremism boundary low confidence.

title: Spiritual Enlightenment, the Damnedest Thing
locator: Author’s Damnedest page and excerpt: teacher/master, a singular ultimate Truth and awakening are treated as authoritative realization rather than a historical account of beliefs.

title: Spiritual Formation
locator: Nouwen organization’s exact book page: five classical stages of spiritual formation and fuller encounter with God; authorized posthumous collection.

title: Tao of Philosophy
locator: Alan Watts estate’s Tao of Philosophy description expressly rejects offering doctrine and presents philosophical change of perspective; book-form identity is established separately in the retained edition record.

title: Tao Te Ching
locator: UCSD scholar’s Daoist canon account and Columbia/CUHK book description identify the named text as foundational scripture, despite its extensive philosophical uses.

title: The Alphabet Versus the Goddess
locator: Publisher states alphabetic literacy reconfigured brain function and caused patriarchy; linguist Mark Newbrook’s direct analysis identifies language/script confusion and unsupported cultural causation. His comment qualifies the disputed Chinese word-category point, which is not decisive here.

title: The Amen Effect
locator: Author’s Big Idea page: connection and care through stories, personal experience and communal practice; spiritual and biological need does not itself assert religious doctrine as authoritative truth.

title: The Ascent of Humanity
locator: Author chapter 7.04: water-information and homeopathy claim, then Emoto images whose lack of rigorous controls is acknowledged while they still support the asserted transition. This is not merely conditional forecasting.

title: The Biggest Con

title: The Biology of Belief
locator: Exact publisher description ties gene regulation to energetic messages from thoughts; the unsupported inference, not the real existence of epigenetics, is the retained failure.

title: The Body Keeps the Score
locator: Specialist claim audit examines 122 propositions. Retain the specific critique of overgeneralized brain and treatment claims; do not generalize this to rejection of trauma or all therapies.

title: The Book of Invasions (Lebor Gabála Érenn)
locator: CELT offers Macalister’s published Lebor Gabala Erenn volumes. The nominated object is a primary medieval origin narrative in a scholarly edition, not a modern devotional appeal.

title: The Book of Life
locator: Book-of-Life text and Krishnamurti transcript reject belief, dogma, saviors and imposed authority. Daily reflective arrangement alone is not decisive evidence of devotion.

title: The Business Blockchain
locator: Wiley excerpt pp.1–4: business-specific fit, honest-network assumptions and historical analogies with limits; p.18 addresses volatility; p.24 explicitly states that not everything fits blockchain and explains state machines. Promotional claims and technical simplifications remain low-scored.

title: The Case for God
locator: Publisher excerpt and reading guide: historical practice and uncertainty contrasted with mandatory doctrinal assent. It advocates a religious sensibility but does not establish a compulsory doctrine.

title: The Color of Compromise
locator: Publisher identifies the nominated historical/sociological book separately from its study guide. Christian motivation and civic reform are not sufficient for V5.

title: The Communist Manifesto
locator: Chapter II: political supremacy, coercive property measures and confiscation from emigrants/rebels. Chapter IV: forcible overthrow. Specific coercive prescriptions support V5 independently of the title; later historical regimes are not substituted as evidence.

title: The Decline of the West
locator: Volume II political chapters: imperialism is asserted as necessary to every civilization and Caesarism as inevitable. The scholarly introduction notes political contingency; that nuance does not establish the necessary morphologic sequence.
